summary: Future FinTech Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into securities purchase agreements on July 29, 2026, to issue 30,000,000 shares at $1.00 per share for $30 million gross proceeds. Controlling shareholder WICL purchased 10 million shares, increasing its ownership from 27.0% to 32.9%. The price was set at a premium to Nasdaq Minimum Price, avoiding stockholder approval under Listing Rule 5635(d). A 19.99% beneficial ownership cap and change-of-control limitation apply. No board recommendation or advisors named. This is a private placement, classified under Capital Returns as a capital-raising transaction, though not a shareholder return. Watch for potential stockholder approval if caps are exceeded.
